**Finding: missing** (TRANSITION) — validated redline submitted.

- **What I checked:** § 17 (Term and Termination, incl. continuation at p0124–p0129), § 18 (survival), § 16 (escrow), § 8 (rejection/refund), § 14 (confidentiality), § 4 (data conversion), plus keyword sweeps for "data" and "termination".
- **Gap:** Exit obligations run one way only — we must cease use and certify destruction/return of Garman's Software, Documentation and Codes within 30 days (§ 17(b)), while Garman owes nothing on exit. § 8(b) returns our Confidential Information only if we reject the Software under § 7; § 14 has no return-on-termination mechanic; § 16 escrow only releases source code. Neither the preferred nor the fallback position (90 days' assistance + 30-day export) is met.
- **Fix:** New § 17(d) inserted after p0129 at the preferred position — up to six months' transition assistance at Garman's then-current rates, return of our data and Confidential Information within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter. The comment flags 90 days' assistance as an available fallback.
